thread:
darren: customer reported p99 latency spike on /v1/generate starting ~09:10 UTC, multiple slow requests, complaining about timeouts

oncall-bot: alert: p99 > 2.5s for org: acme-inc — triggered at 1729954900 — severity: high

alice (oncall): looking — can someone grab traces & the rollout history? any deploys at 09:00-09:05?

ben (eng-runtime): there was a model variant rollout at 08:58 (model: redwood-rlhf-1.2 -> redwood-rlhf-1.3). not a full rollout but traffic-shift to canary 30%

carla (sre): checking autoscaler & GPU pool — autoscaler metrics show scale-ups delayed (avg spin-up 90s) and GPU OOMs around 09:03. also see KV cache miss rate jumped from 5%->48% for that model

ben (eng-runtime): KV cache miss spike suggests incompatible kv-key format after model change. that would increase token recompute and latency. good catch.

alice (oncall): mitigation plan (quick): 1) throttle org acme-inc to reduce headroom pressure 2) route their traffic to fallback model variant in us-west-2 3) enable circuit breaker for long tails 4) rollback canary if needed. I'll apply 1-3 now.

carla (sre): I'll push a temporary circuit-breaker rule on the edge for /v1/generate: if backend latency > 2s -> return 503 after 800ms. config snippet:
```yaml
circuit_breakers:
  - route: /v1/generate
    threshold_ms: 2000
    timeout_ms: 800
    action: fail_fast
```

ben (eng-runtime): to route to fallback model run: `rwinfctl routing update --org acme-inc --route /v1/generate --fallback-model redwood-rlhf-1.2-small --region us-west-2 --weight 100`

alice (oncall): applying rate limit for acme-inc: `rwctl rate set --org acme-inc --limit 40rps --burst 80` — doing that now.

oncall-bot: command accepted. rate limit updated.

ben (eng-runtime): also adding a temporary cache-compat shim to treat old kv keys as compatible (hotfix) — pushing to canary now. if that works we can remove fallback routing.

darren (support): let me message the customer with ETA: "We've throttled and routed you to a fallback model while we fix a bug — you may see slightly different output but faster responses. ETA for full restore ~30-45m."

eva (product): flagging for postmortem: need to include model-compat checks on rollout gating, and add smoke test for KV cache compatibility.

carla (sre): observed p95 dropped from 1.8s->1.1s and p99 from 3.6s->1.7s after routing+rate-limit around 09:14. steady but still watching. GPU OOMs stopped.

ben (eng-runtime): hotfix merged to canary — KV cache miss rate back to ~6%. when canary at 100% we can revert fallback route.

alice (oncall): action items: - darren: update customer msg (done) - ben: promote hotfix + coordinate rollback of fallback when stable - carla: run postmortem template and schedule blameless review - eva: add rollout gating requirement to roadmap

oncall-bot: incident ticket created: INC-2026 (latency regression, model rollout) assigned to eng-runtime + eng-sre.

alice (oncall): final note for playbook: include quick commands & order of ops in runbook: (1) check deploys (2) verify kv/cache metrics (3) apply rate limit per-org (4) enable circuit breaker (5) route to fallback model/region (6) push cache-compat shim or rollback model (7) scale pool if needed (8) postmortem

ben (eng-runtime): will add the runbook steps to the eng-oncall playbook repo after wrap. thanks team :thumbsup:

carla (sre): monitoring: will keep 5m cadence checks for next 2 hours. last_message: p99 stable at 1.6s, closing temporary mitigation in 30m if stable.
